name: 二手房市场价快速评估（比较法）

map.二手房市场比较法评估工具，输入3个可比交易案例的价格及调整因素（区位、面积、楼层: A sales comparison tool for resale homes: enter three comparable transactions with adjustments for location, area, floor, fit-out, orientation and age to obtain a weighted average value.
map.📖 查看「二手房市场价快速评估（比较法） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Quick Resale Market Valuation (Sales Comparison) User Guide"
map.评估值 = 可比实例价 × 修正系数: Appraised value = comparable price × adjustment factor
map.待估房产区位调整: Location adjustment for the subject property
map.市场比较法是最常用的二手房评估方法: The sales comparison approach is the most common way to value resale homes
map.可比案例应选择近期成交、地段相近、条件相似的房产: Comparables should be recent sales in a similar location with similar attributes
map.调整因素包括区位、楼层、装修、朝向、房龄等: Adjustment factors cover location, floor, fit-out, orientation and building age
map.建议选择3个以上可比案例以提高准确性: Use at least three comparables to improve accuracy
map.📚 深度解析：二手房比较法快速评估: 📚 In-depth: Quick Sales Comparison for Resale Homes
map.卖房前用 3 个可比案例估算挂牌价。: Estimate a listing price from three comparables before selling.
map.买房时校验中介报价是否被低估或高估。: When buying, check whether the agent's quote is understated or overstated.
map.按区位、楼层、装修、朝向、房龄五项调整。: Adjust on five factors: location, floor, fit-out, orientation and age.
map.案例 2.5/2.6/2.7 万/㎡，均价 2.6 万；区位 +1%、楼层 +1: Comparables at 25,000 / 26,000 / 27,000 yuan per sqm average 26,000; with location +1%, floor +1%, fit-out +1%, orientation 0 and age 0 the total adjustment is +3%, giving an adjusted unit price of 26,780 yuan/sqm; a 100 sqm unit is valued at 2.678 million yuan.
map.若总调整由 +3% 变为 −5%，单价由 2.678 万降到 2.47 万，总价: If the total adjustment moves from +3% to −5%, the unit price drops from 26,780 to 24,700 yuan and the total differs by about 208,000 yuan, showing how much factor scoring drives the result and why it must be evidence based.
map.优先选同小区或 1 公里内、同户型朝向、近 3 个月成交，楼层与装修差异用调整系: Prefer the same estate or within 1 km, the same layout and orientation, sold within the last 3 months; use adjustment factors to offset floor and fit-out differences, and avoid forcing comparisons across submarkets.
map.总调整幅度一般多大？: How large is the total adjustment normally?
map.单套合理总调整多在 ±10% 内，超过说明案例可比性差或因素打分失真，应增换案例: A reasonable total adjustment per unit is usually within ±10%; beyond that comparability is weak or factor scoring is distorted, so add or swap comparables.
map.二手房市场比较法评估工具以3个可比交易案例为基础，根据区位、楼层、装修、朝向和房: The tool builds on three comparable transactions, adjusting for location, floor, fit-out, orientation and age to give a weighted average unit price and total value.
